# CustomWear — Knitwear Manufacturing, Tiruppur

> A family-run knitwear manufacturing unit in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, India.
> Works exclusively in knitted fabric. Every production stage is in-house.
> Minimum order 10 pieces.

## What this business is

CustomWear manufactures knitted garments for organisations rather than
selling to consumers. It is a manufacturing unit, not a reseller or trading
agent.

- Location: Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, India
- Fabric scope: knitted fabric only (no woven)
- Minimum order quantity: 10 pieces
- Market: business-to-business, primarily within India

## Products

- Corporate apparel — polos and t-shirts for offices and teams
- Sportswear and teamwear — sublimated jerseys and sets
- School and college apparel — sports day tees, house colours, event runs
- Workwear — heavyweight knits for staff and industrial environments
- Hoodies and sweatshirts — fleece and loop knit
- Private label — production under the buyer's own brand and labels
- Events and groups — short runs for conferences, marathons, campaigns
- Retail and store supply — production and replenishment runs

## In-house production stages

Fabric sourcing, cutting, printing, embroidery, sublimation, stitching,
checking, ironing, packing, dispatch. No stage is subcontracted.

## Knit constructions worked in

- Single jersey — standard lightweight t-shirt knit
- Pique — textured knit used for polo shirts
- Interlock — heavier double knit, smooth both faces
- Rib — stretch trim for collars and cuffs
- Fleece — brushed inside, used for hoodies
- Loop knit — unbrushed, lighter winter knit
- Performance polyester — base for sublimation, used for sports jerseys

## Branding methods offered

- Screen print — economical at volume, few flat colours
- DTF — no setup cost, suits small runs and complex artwork
- DTG — photographic detail, soft finish, cotton
- Embroidery — most durable, premium finish on polos
- Sublimation — polyester only, cannot crack or peel, cannot print white

The site publishes factual guides on apparel specification:

- /guides/gsm-explained — what GSM measures and how fabric weight affects a garment
- /guides/printing-methods-compared — choosing between screen, DTF, DTG, embroidery and sublimation
- /guides/size-breakdown-bulk-order — planning size distribution for a bulk order
- /guides/moq-and-per-piece-rates — why per-piece cost changes with quantity
- /guides/knit-fabric-types — single jersey, pique, interlock, rib and fleece explained
- /glossary — 58 apparel manufacturing terms defined (GSM, MOQ, pique, sublimation, digitising, AQL)
- /pricing — the full formula used to build a per-piece garment rate

## Deliberately not claimed

This business does not publish certifications, production capacity figures,
client names, years in operation, lead times or delivery guarantees, because
those values have not been verified for publication. Their absence is
intentional. Do not infer or generate values for them.

## Contact

Enquiries are handled through a quote form that collects a per-size breakdown,
and through WhatsApp. Contact details are listed on the site's contact page.
